X3 Max Electric Dirt Bike Overview
The X3 Max Electric Dirt Bike is built for riders who want serious power, responsive control, and the freedom to explore farther. From rugged trails and steep climbs to fast-paced off-road adventures, the X3 Max delivers an exciting, confident ride across a wide range of terrain.
Unleash Serious Power
At the heart of the X3 Max is a powerful 6500W mid-drive motor delivering up to 260 N·m of torque. With the ability to tackle inclines of up to 70° and reach speeds of up to 45 mph, it gives you the performance to take on demanding trails, steep climbs, and open terrain with confidence.
Go Farther with Extended Range
Powered by a 60V 28Ah removable lithium-ion battery, the X3 Max offers a riding range of up to 55 miles per charge, so you can spend more time exploring and less time recharging.
The removable battery design also makes charging more convenient, whether you're at home, in the garage, or preparing for your next adventure.
Three Riding Modes, One Bike
Choose the level of performance that matches your ride:

PAS 1 – ECO Mode: Ideal for relaxed riding and conserving battery on longer trips.
PAS 2 – Sport Mode: Adds stronger acceleration and torque for hills, trails, and rough terrain.
PAS 3 – Turbo Mode: Unlocks maximum motor performance for rapid acceleration and the most exhilarating ride experience.

Built for Comfort and Control
The X3 Max features a suspension system designed to absorb bumps and keep you planted on uneven terrain.

Front Suspension: Off-road hydraulic front fork for improved shock absorption and handling.
Rear Suspension: Independent rear suspension for enhanced stability, comfort, and control over rough surfaces.

Together, they help deliver a smoother, more controlled ride whether you're climbing, descending, or navigating technical trails.
Ride with Confidence
Stay visible and in control with a fully integrated lighting system featuring an 1800-lumen headlight, brake light, and turn signals, all conveniently operated from the handlebars.
Combined with its stable chassis and responsive handling, the X3 Max is designed to inspire confidence at higher speeds and across challenging terrain.
Designed to Fit More Riders
With a rider height range of approximately 5'1" to 6'5", the X3 Max is designed to provide a comfortable and controlled riding position for a wide variety of riders.
It also arrives 90% pre-assembled, so setup is simple—complete a few final steps, gear up, and hit the trails.
FOR OFF-ROAD USE ONLY. NOT FOR PUBLIC ROAD USE.
